MorphoVaultsMeta.$comment:
Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Morpho ERC-4626 vault on Arc. Constructor takes only the NAV proxy, so its CREATE2 address is fleet-wide (DeploySalts.MORPHO_VAULTS_META = 2) — originally 0x64e1ba8B12ee2bFdBDdFd4E0863EdfaaE824C86a (as on chain 1); since PR #338 (2026-09-30) 0x72a012B30b240458C3f79fd20E5c2A907d77e54f, again fleet-wide. The active vault set lives on NAVCalculator via addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, seeded from nav-config/meta-balance-adapters/5042.json. Identity derived on-chain: positionId = vault address; name = vault name().

The adapter is PURE ERC-4626 — it reads asset(), balanceOf and the redeem value, and never touches the Morpho singleton. That matters on Arc: MORPHO() REVERTS on the KPK wARS Yield vault (measured 2026-09-17, exactly as on the chain-1 wARS vault), so a Morpho-singleton dependency would have blocked this. previewRedeem(1e18) and convertToAssets(1e18) both answer 1e18.
